text.body:
kaṭākṣakiraṇācānta namanmohābdhaye namaḥ| anantānandakṛṣṇāya jaganmaṅgalamūrtaye ||1||
ahamasmi sadā bhāmi kadācinnāhamapriyaḥ| brahmaivāhamataḥ siddhaṃ saccidānandalakṣaṇam ||2||
mayyevodeti cidvyomni jagadgandharvapattanam| ato'haṃ na kathaṃ brahma sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam ||3||
na svataḥ pratyabhijñānān niraṃśatvānna cānyataḥ| na cāśrayavināśānme vināśaḥ syādanāśrayāt ||4||
na śoṣaploṣavikleda cchedāścinnabhaso mama| satyairapyanilāgnyambhaḥ śastraiḥ kimuta kalpitaiḥ ||5||
abhārupasya viśvasya bhānaṃ bhāsaṃnidhervinā| kadācinnāvakalpeta bhā cāhaṃ tena sarvagaḥ ||6||
na hi bhānādṛte satvaṃ narte bhānaṃ cito'citaḥ| citsambhedo'pi nādhyāsāt ṛte tenāhamadvayaḥ ||7||
na deho nendriyaṃ cāhaṃ na prāṇo na mano na dhīḥ| mamatāparīrabdhatvāt akrīḍatvādidaṃ dhiyaḥ ||8||
sākṣī sarvānvitaḥ preyān ahaṃ nāhaṃ kadācana| pariṇāmapariccheda paritāpairūpaplavāt ||9||
supte'hami na dṛśyante duḥkhadoṣapravṛttayaḥ| atastasyaiva saṃsāro na me saṃsartṛsākṣiṇaḥ ||10||
suptaḥ suptiṃ na jānāti nāsupte svapnajāgarau| jāgratsvapnasuṣuptīnāṃ sākṣyato'hamatadṛśaḥ ||11||
vijñānaviratiḥ suptis tajjanma svapnajāgarau| tatsākṣiṇaḥ kathaṃ me syur nityajñānasya te trayaḥ ||12||
ṣaḍ vikāravatāṃ vettā nirvikāro'hamanyathā| tadvikārānusandhānaṃ sarvathā nāvakalpate ||13||
tena tena hi rūpeṇa jāyate līyate murhuḥ| vikāri vastu tasyaiṣām anusandhātṛtā kutaḥ ||14||
na ca svajanma nāśaṃ vā draṣṭurhati kaścana| tau hi prāguttarābhāva caramaprathamakṣaṇau ||15||
na prakāśe'hamityuktir yatprakāśanibandhanā| svaprakāśaṃ tamātmānam aprakāśaḥ kathaṃ spṛśet ||16||
tathāpyābhāti ko'pyeṣa vicārābhāvajīvanaḥ| avaśyāyaścidākāśe vicārārkodayāvadhiḥ ||17||
ātmājñānamahānidrā jṛmbhite'sminjaganmaye| dīrghasvapne sphurantyete svargamokṣādivibhramāḥ ||18||
jaḍājaḍavibhāga'yam ajaḍe mayi kalpitaḥ| bhittibhāge same citra carācaravibhāgavat ||19||
cetyoparāgarupā me sākṣitāpi na tātvikī| upalakṣaṇameveyaṃ nistaraṅgacidambudheḥ ||20||
amṛtābdherna me jīrṇir mṛṣā ḍiṇḍīrajanmabhiḥ| sphaṭikārdrerna me rāgaḥ svāpnasaṃdhyābhravibhramaiḥ ||21||
svarūpameva me satvaṃ na tu dharmo nabhastvavat| madanyasya sato'bhāvān na hi sā jātiriṣyate ||22||
svarūpameva me jñānaṃ na guṇaḥ sa guṇo yadi| anātmatvamasatvaṃ vā jñeyājñeyatvayoḥ patet ||23||
ahameva sukhaṃ nānyad anyaccennaiva tat sukham| amadarthaṃ na hi preyo madarthaṃ na svataḥ priyam ||24||
na hi nānāsvarūpaṃ syād ekaṃ vastu kadācana| tasmādakhaṇḍa evāsmi vijahajjāgatīṃ bhidām ||25||
parokṣatāpariccheda śābalyāpohanirmalam| tadasīti girā lakṣyam ahamekarasaṃ mahaḥ ||26||
upaśāntajagajjīva śiṣyācāryeśvarabhramam| svataḥ siddhamanādyantaṃ paripūrṇamahaṃ mahaḥ ||27||
lakṣmīdharakaveḥ sukti śaradambhojasambhṛtaḥ| advaitamakarando'yaṃ vidvadbhṛṅgairnipīyatām ||28||
